title: Build a for/range loop
idea: Arrange and complete real for/range loops: header with range(n), colon, and an indented body.

exercises.prompt: Arrange a loop that prints Hi 3 times.
exercises.explanation: Header with range(3) first, then the indented body. That prints Hi three times.

exercises.prompt: Build the loop header that repeats 5 times.
exercises.explanation: The header is: for i in range(5): — ending with a colon, ready for an indented body.
The text Go goes in quotes inside print. The loop runs it four times.
Needs the colon AND the indented body AND a name after for. The others each drop one piece.

exercises.prompt: Arrange: print a header once, then Hi 2 times.
exercises.explanation: Header once (un-indented, before), then the loop header, then the indented repeated body.

exercises.prompt:
Fill the keyword that starts a counting loop:

____ i in range(3):
    print("Hi")
exercises.explanation: The keyword is for. 'for i in range(3):' sets up three passes.
The header must end with a colon: for i in range(3): — then the indented body.

exercises.prompt: Build a full one-line body that prints Done.
exercises.explanation: print, (, the text in quotes, ). This becomes the indented body of your loop.
range(3) repeats the body three times — three Hi lines. You built a working for/range loop.

exercises.prompt: After building a loop, the last habit is to...
options: Check the output matches the goal
exercises.explanation: Always Check. Build it, trace it, confirm it does what the problem asked.
